content.text:
The scores below vary in reliability. The pass releases and the stroke rate are reasonably firm. The far-hoop outcomes are mostly firm. The juggle count is a rough estimate.

1. **juggle-touches: 56.** The left player's ball is tiny and the sheets are small, so I couldn't count touches individually. I saw a kick about every 0.5 s with occasional double touches. I subtracted time for about four floor drops (around 4.2, 7.4, 9.8–10.8 and 19.2–19.5 s). The plausible range is 45–70.
2. **far-hoop-shots: made on 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 11; missed on 1, 6, 7, 8, 12 and 13.** I took the 13 shot releases from where the ball left the shooter's hands (about 0.8, 6.3, 10.2, 14.1, 18.6, 23.0, 26.7, 30.6, 35.8, 40.2, 46.1, 50.6 and 55.8 s). I then read where the ball ended up below the rim. Made shots drop straight down under the net. Missed shots fall about 15–20 px left of it, in front of the rim.
   - Shots 6, 8 and 12 were close calls. I checked full-size stills of each at the moment the ball dropped below the rim, and in all three it was clearly left of the net.
